post.description:
Close the upload phase and forward the session's MP4s to VSS.

The handoff awaits the VSS summary and stores it as the session
result; without a configured VSS the session stays in_progress.
Finishing an already-finished session repeats the stored status
without forwarding again.

Answer a question over a recorded trail's clips (#106).

Honest gating like the finish handoff: without a configured VSS
there is no fabricated answer, only a 503.

post.description:
A sky clip plus this month's climate normals become an outlook.

Honest gating like every model seam: unconfigured means 503, and an
unusable model reply is a 502, never an invented forecast.

A condition clip answers the current node's one question (#130).

The reply is a suggestion the screen prefills; nothing writes to the
transcript until the user confirms through the answer route. A node
whose answer source is user-only refuses rather than answers.
One utterance to text on the box; plain STT with its trace.

Synthesize narration on the box. The id is content-addressed, so
a repeated node question replays the cached audio without a second
synthesis; the stored trace reports the original one.

Loose spoken phrasing resolves to the current node's states.

The app's exact gate already matched listed options; this route
handles everything else through the box LLM. A miss keeps the walk
unchanged, and the reply is a suggestion shaped like an observe
result so the same confirm affordance renders.

A spoken answer for the current node. Exact matches only: an
unrecognized utterance comes back as ask_again and changes nothing,
so a garbled transcript can never advance the walk (#80).

ChatTool.title: ChatTool
ChatTool.description: Widget an answer can launch preloaded; prime names the model context.

CoachClipResult.title: CoachClipResult
CoachClipResult.description: One clip's classification and the pointer after it.

CoachSessionCreate.title: CoachSessionCreate
CoachSessionCreate.description: Names the knot to coach; the step list comes back in the state.

CoachSessionState.title: CoachSessionState
CoachSessionState.description: The pointer plus the full step list, recomputed from the transcript.

CoachStep.title: CoachStep
CoachStep.description: One coached step: the screen fragment and the spoken line.

IdentificationRecord.title: IdentificationRecord
IdentificationRecord.description:
One candidate from the box perception relay (#105): the model that
produced it, the candidate label, and its score.

IngestEntry.title: IngestEntry
IngestEntry.description: One clip's place in the VSS handoff while a finish runs (#106).

NarrationCreated.title: NarrationCreated
NarrationCreated.description: A synthesized narration, fetchable at audio_url until server restart.

NarrationRequest.title: NarrationRequest
NarrationRequest.description: Text to synthesize; voice picks a Kokoro voice, absent for default.

SessionCreateRequest.title: SessionCreateRequest
SessionCreateRequest.description: Optional creation body; a session without one accepts either kind.

SessionFinished.title: SessionFinished
SessionFinished.description: Acknowledgement of the finish trigger; poll the results route next.

SkyOutlook.title: SkyOutlook
SkyOutlook.description: A sky reading joined with climate memory (pitch scene three).

SpeechTrace.title: SpeechTrace
SpeechTrace.description: Where a speech inference ran; shown raw in the app's traces tab.

TrailAnswer.title: TrailAnswer
TrailAnswer.description: The VSS agent's answer over the session's clips: implication first.

TrailQuestion.title: TrailQuestion
TrailQuestion.description: A question asked over a finished trail session (#106).

TranscriptionResult.title: TranscriptionResult
TranscriptionResult.description: One utterance transcribed on the box.

WalkAnswer.title: WalkAnswer
WalkAnswer.description:
A confirmed observation. `states` selects any-of within the
character; empty or absent alongside a None `state` records a skip,
which filters nothing. `state` remains for single-answer clients.

WalkGuideCard.title: WalkGuideCard
WalkGuideCard.description: One identification guide the walkthrough can run (#129).

WalkObservation.title: WalkObservation
WalkObservation.description:
A camera suggestion for one node (#130): never written to the
transcript; the user confirms through the answer route.

WalkSessionCreate.title: WalkSessionCreate
WalkSessionCreate.description:
Names the guide to walk; absent means the fungi walk, so pre-#129
clients that post no body keep their exact behavior.

WalkSessionState.title: WalkSessionState
WalkSessionState.description:
The whole session, recomputed from the transcript on every response.

danger_species carries full cards on every step (#136); candidates
carries them when the survivor set is small or the walk is complete and
stays absent while the set is large. The counts are always present.

WalkUtteranceResult.title: WalkUtteranceResult
WalkUtteranceResult.description:
A spoken walk answer: the transcript, what it mapped to, and the
session after applying it. ask_again means nothing matched exactly and
the node did not advance.
